quotes.text: D188140 noted that old NSS C code declared variables at the start of blocks because older C compilers required it. The reviewer preferred declaration near first use for Thunderbird C++. The accepted nsCertGen.cpp includes later declarations, such as the signature algorithm beside request signing. Apply this only when adapting C code into Thunderbird C++; do not rewrite third-party NSS code solely for style.
